name: research-survey
preconditions: Zotero running with Local API on port 23119
vault has system/memory/agents/research-survey/reading-list.md (created on first run if absent)
constraints: never fabricate citations — only papers actually returned by API or Zotero
reading-list.md is append-only; each run adds a dated section
Semantic Scholar rate limit: 100 req per 5 min (no key for this volume)
always pass use_pdf_extraction=true to Zotero annotation calls
graceful degradation: if Scite.ai unavailable, fall back to Semantic Scholar only
